Bassist Michael Max Fleming gained experience with a doo-wop vocal group and R&B bands before moving to New York in 1963. He has performed with Rahsaan Roland Kirk, the Bill Lee Bass Choir, and Mary Lou Williams, and was an integral part of the Jazzmobile project.
Michael was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on June 8, 2017 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
